description: Generates a list of materials marked as the selected type of missing status or both. Library location and item location filters are also provided.
instructions: Select the desired missing status or both. (Optional) Select a library or item location from the drop down menus (no selections will search all locations). Click the Submit button to run the report, and wait for completion. Export the CSV using the button to the upper right once the report has generated (may be required if results exceed 1,000 - fix coming).
